scenario: drawing retransmission fixes two one-band sends before a five-band cursor-50 stall

tags.drawing: HELLO, HELLO AGAIN, five-band text, then a four-band dot

notes: The acknowledgement-retransmission firmware delivered HELLO and HELLO AGAIN consecutively. Both host rebroadcasts are complete; HELLO includes offset 0x0640, whose earlier omission visibly removed the lower half of its final O. A later 67-reply five-band text transfer is contiguous only through offset 0x1e00 and stalls at cumulative cursor 50. The following four-band dot times out after the participant stops progressing. This capture proves the one-band clipping fix but is negative evidence for the current multi-band sliding ring.
